reason: The existing mapping to Article 28(3) of Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 provides a defensible and sufficiently complete regulatory basis. The provision explicitly requires financial entities to report at least yearly to the competent authority on the number of new ICT service arrangements, the categories of providers, the types of contracts, and the functions supported, which directly corresponds to the control objective.
applicability_note: This control is applicable to financial entities as defined in DORA, which are required to maintain an ICT third-party register and report on it annually.
challenge_comment: The mapping is direct and the evidence is clear. No challenge to the adequacy of the mapping is identified.
